notes: Batch A of the Stage 2 walkthrough punch list. Nine changes, eight of them removals, one unblocking. Phone-only: no server, no migration, no brand-web.

founder_decisions_2026_08_27.which_sets: SALES SETS ONLY. Pay-for-content sets keep their posting window, budget and format counts — the budget is the figure the wallet must cover before publishing, so removing it there would stop content campaigns going live.
founder_decisions_2026_08_27.minimum_channels: REMOVE. 'Channels a creator may use' is the only survivor in that block, trimmed to Instagram and YouTube. Minimum-channels was guidance that never blocked anyone anyway.
founder_decisions_2026_08_27.batching: TWO BATCHES. Batch A now (removals + optional offer). Batch B next: the offer moves to creator level and the phone builder reaches parity with web — screens drawn and agreed first.
founder_decisions_2026_08_27.old_stage_strip: REBUILD the campaign screen to match Stage 3, as its OWN stage. Not folded into this punch list.
founder_decisions_2026_08_27.hidden_creators_explanation: REMOVE ENTIRELY. I proposed keeping the fact as a plain sentence and showed it on board 3; he saw the trade-off and said it is not necessary. Consequence, accepted: the six are still filtered out and the screen no longer says why.
founder_decisions_2026_08_27.step_4_offer_routes: Asked on 2026-08-27 to remove 'See what a shopper pays', then WITHDREW it the same day once told that button is the only navigate() into BrandBasketPreview (BrandSetWizardScreen.js:311). KEEP IT. Step 4 changes only in that the offer stops being compulsory.

verified_against_production_2026_08_27.campaign_sets_has_no_offer_columns: Confirmed by information_schema. The offer lives on campaign_influencers (brand_offer_id, offer_type, offer_config_json, offer_expires_at, offer_valid_until, promoted_brand_offer_ids), all nullable.
verified_against_production_2026_08_27.conclusion: The data model has always held offers PER CREATOR and has never required one. The wizard invented the mandatory set-level rule. Making it optional is a correction, not a relaxation.

known_live_defect_not_fixed_here.effect: Every offer built on a phone silently applies to the WHOLE STORE. Ask for '20% off sarees' and you get 20% off everything.
known_live_defect_not_fixed_here.why_not_now: It is part of the builder-parity work in Batch B, which needs boards. Batch A reduces the exposure by not forcing anyone through that builder to save a set.
known_live_defect_not_fixed_here.first_flagged: features/stage-2-build-a-campaign-from-the-phone/06-diff/notes.md section 2.3a, 2026-08-25 — the founder independently hit it on 2026-08-27.

scope_excluded: Batch B — the offer at creator level, and the phone builder reaching parity with web (free-gift type, scope, redemption channels, the pay-at-store applicability warning)
The campaign screen's old six-stage strip (Fund · Roster · Contracts · Production · Review · Payout) — its own stage

release.deploy_class: production-impacting (brand app OTA only — no backend, no migration, no web).
release.outward_facing: None. No shopper, creator or admin surface changes.
release.device_walk_required: YES. W1-W3 in 02-workflow.md. W2 is the one that matters: a pay-for-content set must be EXACTLY as it was, and a removal leaking into that branch would not crash — it would silently strip a field and refuse to publish later.
